lessons_used: Post-adoption sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; moving sign-in pre-photo or post-waiting hurt or had no clear effect, while safety and sync hints showed no clear effect.

Path selection clarity/value headlines, spotlight layouts, and visual story redesigns won; checklist layouts, scroll redesigns, and reassurance notes hurt, while simplified copy showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints won; completion timers, progress trackers, sound alerts, and compatibility checks showed no clear effect.

Split photo upload preview layouts won; compact grids, guidelines banners, mascot stamp redesigns, and multi-step inspection flows hurt adoption, while pre-adoption reviews and incentives showed no clear effect.

Interactive spawn placement flows, placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while docking hints and welcome redesigns showed no clear effect.

Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive flow additions (such as placement verification screens and spawn placement flows) and overpredicted gains on severe flow failures (such as stamp redesigns, multi-step inspection, and guided spawn stages).

lessons_next: Sign-in: Post-adoption timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; reordering sign-in elsewhere and adding sync or safety notices showed no clear effect.

Choose Path: Headline updates emphasizing clarity/value, spotlight layouts, visual stage redesigns, and outcome clarity tips won; checklist layouts, scroll redesigns, and reassurance notes hurt, while simplified copy showed no clear effect.
Home: Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints won; progress trackers, sound alerts, completion timers, and compatibility checks showed no clear effect.

Adoption: Photo quality guide previews and split preview layouts won; compact grids, guidelines banners, mascot stamps, fallback flows, spotlight selection views, and multi-step inspection flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews and incentives showed no clear effect.

Finish: Interactive spawn placement flows, placement verification screens, and tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while docking hints and welcome redesigns showed no clear effect.

Predictions: Underpredicted gains on counter-intuitive flow additions (such as placement verification screens and spawn placement flows) and overpredicted performance on severe flow failures (such as mascot stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, and guided spawn stages).
